integrity: The optimum and complete equality layer were reconstructed from exact finite linear algebra. The packaged verifier independently enumerates subspaces and fitting matrices and records all counts used in the claim.
scientific_limitations: Classification is restricted to five one-bit messages, binary scalar linear encoders, and the side-information graph \(C_5\); nonlinear, vector, and asymptotic encoders are outside scope.
title: Complete binary scalar index-code classification for the pentagon
